v: Ha in Pablo in, schekab' in Jesucristo, yujnhej to icha chi' ix el t'a sk'ool Dios. Ha in yet' winh kuk'tak Timoteo, sko tz'ib'ejb'at jun ko carta tik t'ayex yiglesia exxo Dios t'a chonhab' Corinto. Sko tz'ib'anpaxb'at t'ayex he masanil ex yikexxo Dios t'a yol yik Acaya.
Ko gana syak' swach'k'olal ko Mam Dios yet' Kajal Jesucristo t'ayex ta', syak'anpax sjunk'olal.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Dios, haton Smam Kajal Jesucristo, ko Mam ton paxi, tz'ok' sk'ool t'ayonh, syak' wal sniwanil ko k'ool yujto ko Diosal yaji.

Ayik sja ko yaelal, ha Dios tz'ak'an sniwanil ko k'ool, yik wach' syal pax kak'an sniwanil sk'ool heb' tz'ab'an pax syail. Icha syutej Dios yak'an sniwanil ko k'ool, icha pax chi' skutej kak'an sniwanil sk'ool heb'.
Icha wal tz'aj kab'an syaelal yet' Cristo, icha pax chi' syutej yak'an sniwanil ko k'ool.

Yuj chi', icha chi' tzonh aji ayik skab'an syail, yik wach' syal kak'an sniwanil he k'ool yik tek'an tzeyutej he b'a. Hanhejtona', ayik syak'an sniwanil ko k'ool Dios, icha chi' tzonh aji, yik wach' syal kak'an sniwanil he k'ool, yuj chi' syal he tek'b'an he b'a eyak'an techaj juntzanh yaelal ol ak'jok och t'a eyib'anh icha tz'ak'jioch t'a kib'anh a onh tik.
Tek'an skutej ko b'a kak'anoch Dios yipok ko k'ool eyuuj, yujto kojtak to icha tzeyutej eyab'an syail ket'ok, icha pax chi' ol aj yak'anpax sniwanil he k'ool Dios ket'ok.

Ex wuk'tak ex wanab', sko nib'ej skal t'ayex jantak syail ix kab'i ayik ix onh ek' t'a yol yik Asia. Yujto te ya' ix onh ek' ta', ijan maj techajlaj kuuj. Ix ko na' to ijan wal maj onh kolchajel-laj t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Ha ko naani to ol onh cham ta'. Icha chi' utab'il onh ta', yik wach' anhej Dios skak'och yipok ko k'ool, yujto ha' tz'ak'an pax pitzwok heb' chamnak. Xal onh, maxtzak ko na' tato tzonh kolchaji.

Jab'xonhej wal maj onh cham yuj jun niwan yaelal chi', haxo Dios onh kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, wan onh skolan paxel tiknaik. Hanheja' skak'och yipok ko k'ool to ol onh skolelta t'a juntzanh syaelal chi',
tato tzex kolwaj ket' t'a lesal. Tato tzijtum ex tzex lesalwi kuuj, hanhejtona' niwan ex ol eyak' yuj diosal t'a Dios yuj swach'k'olal ol yak' t'ayonh.

Tzonh tzalaji, yujto kojtak wal to tojol skutej ko b'eyb'al t'a masanil heb' anima yet' pax t'ayex. Malaj spaltail ko b'eyb'al, yujto skolwaj Dios yet' swach'k'olal t'ayonh. Manh yujok ko jelanil wach' ko b'eyb'al.

Ayik sko tz'ib'anb'at juntzanh carta t'ayex, anhej juntzanh tas tzeyila' yet' juntzanh tas snachajel eyuuj, a sko tz'ib'ejb'at t'ayex. Tzaxo nachajel jab'ok eyuuj tas kaji. Yuj chi', swak'och yipok in k'ool to ol wach' nachajel eyuuj to ayik ol jax Kajal Jesús, ol yal he k'echaanh kuuj, ich onh pax ta' ol onh k'epaxchaanh eyuuj.
Icha chi' wutejnak wak'anoch yipok in k'ool. Yuj chi', tzin b'ab'laj ek' ex wila'' yik wach' chael tzin ek' t'ayex t'a elanhchamel in naani, haxo he wach' chaan swach'k'olal Dios.
Ha in naani to tzin ek' ex wila'', ichato chi' b'ian tzin ja t'a Macedonia tik. Haxo tzin meltzaji, tzex ek' wilanxi. Tato icha chi', a ex syal tzex kolwaj t'ayin yik tzin b'atxi t'a Judea.

Ayik ix in naan juntzanh tik, ¿tom manh chamok ix in na he naani? ¿Tom tze na'a to tonhej tzin na juntzanh tik icha sna heb' komon anima? ¿Tom tze na'a, to anhej yet' in ti', hinye, xin chi, palta haxo t'a in pensar wan in naani to maay?
Syil Dios, haton tz'elnhejk'och tas syala', a onh tik malaj junelok sko tak'wej ko ti'ok, slajwi chi' skalanxi to manhxo.
Ha in tik, winhaj Silvano yet' winhaj Timoteo ek'nak onh kalel yab'ixal Cristo Jesús Yuninal Dios t'ayex. Ha Cristo chi', malaj junelok yalnak: Hinye, palta haxo t'a spensar yojtak to maay.
Ha tz'ak'an elk'och masanil tas ix yalkan Dios. Yuj chi', a skalan wach' lolonel t'a Dios, skalan amén yuj Cristo Jesús.
Ha Dios tz'ak'an stek'anil he pensar ket'ok, yujto ay onhxo och t'a yol sk'ab' Cristo. Ha Dios ak'jinak kopisio koch schekab'ok.

Ha ak'jinak och jun sello t'ayonh junjun onh, haton Yespíritu. Ha Yespíritu tik sch'oxani to yik onhxo Dios, sch'oxanpax t'ayonh to t'a wal yel ol ko cha juntzanhxo tas yalnak Dios chi' to ol yak' t'ayonh.
Malaj in gana tz'och he kusk'olal wuuj, yuj chi' majto in ek' t'ayex t'a Corinto chi'. Wal yel swala', syil ko Mam Dios yujto yojtak masanil tas ay t'a in pensar.

Malaj ko gana tzex kak' pural, skalan t'ayex tas tzeyutej eyak'anoch Dios t'a he k'ool. Yujto tek'anxo tzeyutej eyak'anoch t'a he k'ool. Palta ko gana tzonh kolwaj t'ayex, yik sko wach' ak'ej he na'a, yik wach' ol ja he tzalajk'olal ta'.
Yuj chi', a tzin na'a, manhxo ol in k'och t'ayex t'a skal kusk'olal.
Tato sb'at wak'och he kusk'olal, ¿machto junok ol ak'anxi in tzalajk'olal? Yuj chi', malaj in gana sb'at wak'och he kusk'olal yujto a exnhej syal eyak'an sniwanil in k'ool.

Yuj chi', icha chi' wutejnak walanb'at t'ayex t'a jun in carta, yujto malaj in gana b'at wak'och he kusk'olal. Yujto a ex wal smoj eyak'an in tzalajk'olal. Swak'anoch yipok in k'ool, yujto tzin na'a, tato sja in tzalajk'olal, ol japax he tzalajk'olal wet'ok.

Ayik in tz'ib'annakb'at jun in carta chi' t'ayex, te ochnak in ilk'olal eyuuj. Ochnak wal pitz'an t'a in k'ool, hanhejtona' ok'nak in pax eyuuj. Palta manh yujok wak'anoch he kusk'olal in tz'ib'ejnakb'ati. In tz'ib'ejnakb'ati yik tzeyojtakejeli to te xajan ex wuuj.
Malaj in gana tzin ek' t'a yib'anh in b'oan yaj jun tik, palta a jun winh ak'jinak och ko kusk'olal, manhok innhej kusnak in, ayex pax kusnak ex janik' wet'ok.
Ha jun yaelal ix eyak'och t'a yib'anh winh ayik ix he molb'an he b'a, k'okb'ilokab'i.
Haxo tiknaik, más wach' tzeyak' niwank'olal winh. Tzeyak'anpax sniwanil sk'ol winh, yik wach' max te juwiel winh yuj kusk'olal.
Yuj chi' tzin tewi t'ayex to tze ch'ox he wach'k'olal t'a winh.
Yuj jun chi' in tz'ib'ejnakb'at jun in carta t'ayex, yik wach' tzex wak' prowal. Yujto in gana swojtakejeli tato yel tze k'anab'ajej tas swala'.

Yuj chi' tato tzeyak' niwank'olal t'a yib'anh jun winh chi', a inxo pax tik, ol wak'pax niwank'olal winh. Tato a in swak' niwank'olal winh, ha t'a yol sat Cristo swak' niwank'olal syal chi', palta yuj he wach'ilok a ex tik.
Icha chi' swutej, yik wach' max onh yak' ganar winh Satanás, yujto kojtakxo tas snib'ej winh t'ayonh.
Ayik in k'och t'a chonhab' Troas, yik swalanel jun wach' ab'ix yik Cristo, ilchaj wuuj to a Kajal Jesús b'oan yaj masanil yik swalel slolonel.
Palta och in ilk'olal, yujto maj ilchaj winh kuk'tak Tito wuj ta'. Yuj chi' walkan kil ko b'a t'a heb' ay chi' ta', in kotxi ta', in ja t'a yol yik Macedonia tik.

Palta kaq'ek yuj diosal t'a Dios, yujto masanil tiempo ha' tzonh ik'anoch tzak'an yet' Cristo Jesús yik scheklajeli to ha' ix ak'an ganar. Kuuj spukaxb'at yab'ixal Cristo t'a junjun lugar, icha spukaxb'at sjab' junok tas suk'uq'ui sjab'.
Icha sjab' stab'il junok tas suk'uq'ui sjab' syak' Cristo t'a Dios, ich onh ta' ayik tzek' kalanel yab'ixal. Spukaxb'at t'a skal heb' skolchaji yet' pax t'a skal heb' wanto sateq'ui.

Ayik skalan t'a heb' wan sateq'ui, lajan yab'ixal chi' icha sjab' junok tas tzonh cham yuj. Haxo tato ha t'a heb' wan skolchaj skaleli, lajan yab'ixal chi' icha junok tas te suk'uq'ui sjab' t'a heb', sch'oxan paxi to ol scha sk'inal heb'. Yuj chi', ¿mach wal junok syal yalanel jun ab'ix tik?

Ha onh tik, manh yujok kak'an ganar t'a spatik slolonel Dios, yuj chi' tzek' kaleli, icha syutej sb'a juntzanhxo heb'. Niwanok tzek' yal heb', palta soman syutej heb' yalani. Palta a onh tik, yel skala', yujto ha Dios ix ak'an kopisio tik. Ha t'a yichanh Dios skala' yujto yik onhxo Cristo heyet'ok.

Ayik skalanb'at juntzanh tik t'ayex, ¿tom tze na' to skal ko b'a wach'ilal t'ayex junelxo? Manh yowalilok sko ch'ox juntzanh carta t'ayex tz'alani tas kopisio, icha syutej sb'a juntzanhxo heb'. Hanhejtona', manh yowalilok sko k'ankot he carta, tzeyalankoti to ay kopisio t'a eyichanh.
Yujto a ex wal wan he ch'oxaneli to ay kopisio. Lajan ex icha junok carta tz'ib'ab'iloch t'a ko pensar, yujto syil heb' anima masanil tas eyaji.

Icha junok carta tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj Cristo a onh kik'nakb'ati, ich ex ta'. Ha jun icha carta tik, manhok t'a tinta tz'ib'ab'ilkani, palta a Yespíritu Dios pitzan, a tz'ib'annakkani. Manhok t'a junok k'een tz'ib'ab'ilochi, palta ha t'a ko pensar, hata' tz'ib'ab'ilochi.
Icha chi' sko na', yujto yuj Cristo skak'och Dios yipok ko k'ool.
Mantok sko na'a to munil syal kuuj ko ch'okoj. Palta yujnhej skolwal Dios syal junok tas kuuj.

Ha ak'jinak kopisio yik skak' serwil, yik skalanpaxel yab'ixal jun schab'il trato. Ha jun strato tik, manh yujok to sko k'anab'ajej junok tas tz'ib'ab'ilkani tz'elk'ochi, palta yujnhej Yespíritu tz'elk'ochi. Ha jun ley tz'ib'ab'ilkani ay yopisio yak'anoch chamel t'a kib'anh. Palta haxo Yespíritu Dios ay yopisio yak'an ko k 'inal t'a junelnhej.

Ha jun ley chi', ha t'a k'een k'een tz'ib'ab'ilkani. Ayik yak'jinakkan jun ley chi', janak kopnaj stzikikial Dios. Haxo heb' israel, maj yal-laj yilan sat winhaj Moisés heb', yujto weei yilji sat winh chi'. Palta a jun swewon chi', k'ojank'olal tupnak yok. Wach'chom ay yopisio jun ley chi' onh smilanchamok, palta ayik sjanak, te niwan ajnak yelk'ochi. Tato icha chi' ajnak yelk'och jun ley chi',
te ek'to wal niwan yelk'och jun ab'ix syik'kot Yespíritu Dios t'ayonh.
Ha jun ley tz'ak'anoch chamel t'a kib'anh chi', niwan ton yelk'ochi. Yuj chi', a junxo ab'ix tz'alani to wach' onh t'a yichanh Dios, másxo wal niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh jun chi'.
Wach'chom ha t'a peka' te niwan yelk'och jun ley chi', palta malaj yelk'och t'a yichanh junxo tik, yujto yelxo wal niwan yelk'och junxo ab'ix tik.
Tato niwan yelk'och jun ley kennhej tiempo ek'nak yopisio chi', syalelk'ochi to a jun ayek' t'a junelnhej, másxo wal niwan yelk'ochi.
Yujto skak'och jun tik yipok ko k'ool, yuj chi' max onh xiw kalaneli.
Manh lajanok skutej ko b'a icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Moisés chi'. Yujto smusejnak sat winh t'a jun k'apak, yik wach' max yil heb' yetisraelal winh stup yok jun swewon chi' t'a sat.

Palta maj nachajel yuj heb' tas syalelk'och jun chi'. Hanhejtona' tiknaik, ayik tz'awtaj b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan jun b'ab'el trato t'a heb', max nachajel-laj yuj heb'. Yujto icha jun k'apak b'aj smusejnak sat winhaj Moisés chi', icha chi' yajoch t'a spensar heb'. Max yal-laj yel jun chi' t'a spensar heb' chi', palta yuj Cristo syal yeli.
Hanhejtona' tiknaik, ayik syab'an heb' yawtaj juntzanh libro yik Moisés chi', ichato hanheja' musan sat heb' yuj jun icha k'apak chi'.
Palta ayik smeltzaj ko pensar t'a Dios Kajal, ichato tz'elxi jun icha k'apak chi' t'a ko pensar.
Ha Kajal, haton Espíritu. Ha onh mach onh b'aj ayoch Yespíritu Kajalil tik, librexo kaji, jakanxo ko sat kilani.

Yuj chi', manhxo ayok och jun icha k'apak chi' t'a ko pensar. Ha tiknaik, lajan onh icha junok nen. Kuuj scheklajel swach'il Kajal Jesús. Wan slajanb'i pax ko pensar yet' Cristo chi', yujto wan yak'an swach'il t'ayonh. Icha chi' wan onh yutan Kajal, haton Yespíritu Dios.
Yujto tz'ok' sk'ool Dios t'ayonh ix yak'an jun kopisio tik, yuj chi' max tak ko k'ool t'ay.

Ay juntzanh tas sk'ulej heb' anima t'a elk'altak, yujto q'uixwelal yaji. Ha onhxo tik, sko chakel juntzanh b'eyb'al chi' t'a junelnhej. Max kak'laj musansatil heb' anima yuj juntzanh tas jelan skutej kalani. Max ko k'ex jab'ok tas syalkan Dios, yujto anhej wal juntzanh tas yel, haton skala'. Icha chi' skutej ko ch'oxanel kopisio t'a junjun anima t'a yichanh Dios, yik snachajel yuj heb' tas kaji.
Ayik tzek' kalanel jun wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il, a heb' wanto sateq'ui, max nachajel-laj yuj heb'.

Ha heb' chi' max yak'ochlaj heb' t'a sk'ool, yujto a winh sdiosal jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik tz'ak'an juwok spensar heb'. Ichato a winh tz'ak'an juwok yol sat heb', yik max och sakil k'inal t'a spensar heb' yuj jun ab'ix tz'alani to a Cristo te niwan yelk'ochi, yuj paxi scheklajeli chajtil yaj Dios.
Ayik tzonh ek' kaleli, manhok kab'ixal tzek' kaleli. Palta anhej tik skala', a Jesucristo Kajal yaji. Skalan paxi to a onh tik tzex kak' serwil yujto sko xajanej Jesús.

Ha Dios alannakkani: Ayokab' sakil k'inal t'a skal k'ik' k'inal tik, xchi. Ha wal tz'ak'anoch sakil k'inal t'a ko pensar yik wach' skojtakejeli to te niwan swach'ilal Dios. Ha t'a Jesucristo, hata' scheklajel swach'ilal Dios chi'.

Ha jun kopisio niwan yelk'och tik, ha' ayoch t'ayonh, palta a onh tik lajan onh icha junok lum chen, yujto malaj wach' kochi, yuj chi' scheklajeli to a jun niwan poder tik, anhej t'a Dios skoti, manh kikok.
Wach'chom oyanoch yaelal t'a ko patik kichanh, palta max onh kanlaj t'a yalanh yuj. Wach'chom somk'olal kaji, palta max ko wach' ak'ej somchajel ko b'a.
Wach'chom tzonh pechji b'eyek' b'aj tzonh b'eyeq'ui, palta manh onh aktab'ilokkani. Wach'chom tzonh mak'ji telwok, palta max onh chamlaj.
Masanil b'ajtak tzonh eq'ui, skab'nhej syaelal yet' ko niwanil tik, icha ajnak yab'an syail Jesús ayik schamnak. Icha chi' tzonh aji, yik scheklajeli to a sk'inal Jesús ayoch t'ayonh.
Yakb'an pitzan onh, masanil tiempo ayoch chamel t'a kib'anh, yujto junxonhej kaj yet' Jesús, yik wach'chom chamelb'a yaj ko niwanil tik, wan scheklajel sk'inal Jesús t'ay.
Yuj chi' a onh tik, ayxo och chamel t'a kib'anh. Ha exxo pax tik, ayxo he k 'inal t'a junelnhej.

Ha t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani ay jun syalkan icha tik: Ix wak'och t'a in k'ool, yuj chi' ix waleli, xchi. Ha onhxo tik, lajan skutej kak'anoch t'a ko k'ool yet' heb'. Skalpaxeli, yujto ix kak'och t'a ko k'ool.
Kojtak to a jun ix ak'an pitzwok Kajal Jesús t'a skal heb' chamnak, A' ol onh ak'anxi pitzwok yuj Jesús. Ol ex pitzwokpax ket'ok, haxo onh yik'anb'at chi' b'aj ayeq'ui.

Masanil juntzanh swal tik, eyuuj ix ak'jioch t'a kib'anh. Icha chi' tzonh utaji, yik tzijtum heb' ol chaan swach'k'olal Dios. Hanhejtona' tzijtum pax heb' ol ak'an yuj diosal t'ay. Yuj chi' scheklajeli to niwan swach'ilal Dios.
Yuj chi', malaj b'aj stakel ko k'ool. Wach'chom wan yichamax jun ko niwanil tik, palta a ko pensar junjun k'u stek'k'aji.
Ha juntzanh yaelal sja t'a kib'anh, malaj yelk'och t'ayonh, yujto elanhchamel tzek'b'ati. Palta yuj ol ko cha jun te niwan yelk'ochi. Ha jun chi' manh jantakok swach'il, aynhejek' t'a junelnhej.

Max kak'och ko pensar t'a juntzanh tas skila', yujto a juntzanh tas skil tik elanhchamel tzek'b'ati. Ha t'a juntzanh tas max kila', hata' skak'och ko pensar, yujto a juntzanh max kil chi', aynhejek' t'a junelnhej.

Ha jun ko niwanil tik, lajan yaj yet' k'apak mantiado, junnhej rato tz'ixtaxi. Kojtak to ayik ol lajwokek' jun ko niwanil tik, ay junxo ol yak' Dios t'ayonh t'a satcha'anh. Ha jun chi' malaj b'ak'uinh ol satelok. Lajan icha junok pat wach' yaj sb'okani, haton jun manhok anima b'oannak, palta haton wal Dios b'oannak.
Yel toni, yakb'an ay onh ek' t'a jun ko niwanil tik, tzonh k'akwi yet'ok, yujto ko gana tz'ak'ji junxo yik satcha'anh t'ayonh, haton junokxo icha pat.
Ol ak'jok jun chi' t'ayonh, ichato spichul ko pixan ol ajok, yik manhxo ol el b'eran.

Ayik aytooch jun ko niwanil tik, tzonh k'akwi, skab'an pax syail yet'ok. Mantok ko gana tz'ik'jiek' jun ko niwanil tik, palta to ko gana tz'ak'ji junxo ko niwanil, yik ol ko cha ko k 'inal t'a junelnhej. Ha jun chi' ol ko cha'a, ayik ol satel jun chamelb'a yaj tik.
Ix onh sb'okan Dios yujnhej wal jun tik, ix yak'anpaxoch Yespíritu t'ayonh, yik skojtakejeli to t'a wal yel ol ko cha jun tik t'ay.
Yuj chi', skak'och Dios yipok ko k'ool t'a masanil tiempo. Kojtak to yakb'an ayto ek' ko pixan t'a jun ko niwanil tik, manto onh ayok ek' t'a ko pat, haton jun b'aj ayek' Kajal Jesús.
Ayik tzonh ek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, anhej t'a Dios skak'och ko pensar. Manhok juntzanh tas skil yet' ko sat b'aj skak'och ko pensar.
Yuj chi' ha Dios skak'och yipok ko k'ool. T'a wal yel ko gana skaktejkan jun ko niwanil tik, yik ol yal ko k'och t'a junxo ko pat b'aj ayek' Kajal Jesús.
Yuj chi' sko say tas wach' skutej ko b'a, yik ol tzalaj Kajal Jesús chi' ket'ok, wach'chom ayonh to ek' yet' ko niwanil tik, mato toxo ix onh k'och b'aj ay Ko Mam Dios.
Yujto yowalil ol onh k'och t'a yichanh sdespacho Cristo, yik junjun onh ol ko cha spak tastak ix ko k'ulej yakb'an ay onh ek' yet' jun ko niwanil tik, tato ay ix och tas ix ko k'ulej chi', mato maay.
Ha onhxo tik, skojtakejel xiwk'olal t'a Kajal Jesús, yuj chi' skak' wal kip kekan sna heb' anima. Ha Dios yojtak tas yaj ko pensar. Ha exxo, ko gana tzeyojtakej pax eli tas yaji.

Mantok tonhej skal ko b'a wach'il t'ayex junelxo. Palta ko gana tzex tzalaj ket'ok, yik ol yal he pakan he b'a t'a juntzanh heb' tonhej skomon ik'ejchaanh sb'a yuj juntzanh tas scheklajel t'a ko sat. Haxo tas ay t'a spensar heb', max snalaj heb' tato wach', mato chuk.
Ha onhxo tik, tato ichato ay tas tz'ixtan yol ko jolom heyilani, yuj kak'an serwil Dios icha chi' tzonh aji. Palta t'a wal yel wach' ko pensar. Icha chi' tzonh aji yuj ex kak'an serwil.
Yujto xajan Cristo kuuj, yuj chi' skak' pural ko b'a kak'an serwil. Yujto ix cham kuuj ko masanil, yuj chi' ichato ix onh champax yet'ok.
Ha Cristo ix cham kuuj ko masanil, yik wach' a onh pitzan onh tik, maxtzak kak' ko gana junjun onh. Palta yik skak' snib'ej jun ix chami ix ak'jixi pitzwok yuj Dios kuuj.

Yuj chi' a onh tik, maxtzak yal kalub'tanhan junok mach yuj tas scheklaj t'ay. Wach'chom ha t'a yalanh, ix kalub'tanhej Cristo yuj tas chekel t'ay, palta a tiknaik, manhxo ichok ta' tz'aj ko naan t'a spatik.
Ha mach junxonhej tz'aj yet' Cristo, toxo ix k'exmaj spensar, ichato ix och ak' animail. Ha juntzanh peka' b'eyb'al, toxo ix lajwi eq'ui. Toxo ix ak'b'ixikan smasanil.
Masanil juntzanh swal tik, ha Dios ix b'oankan t'ayonh. Yuj Cristo ix onh yak'och Dios t'a junk'olal yet'ok. Ha ak'jinak kopisio kalaneli tas tz'aj yoch heb' anima junk'olal yet'ok.

Ha jun tik syalelk'ochi to ha Dios ayoch yet' Cristo, ayik ix uleq'ui, yik tz'och heb' anima masanil junk'olal yet'ok. Maxtzak ak'jioch ko mul t'a kib'anh yuj Dios. Ha ak'jinakkan jun ab'ix tik t'a yol ko k'ab', yik tzek' kaleli chajtil tz'aj yoch heb' anima junk'olal yet'ok.
Yuj chi' schekab' ton Cristo kaji. Icha wal to ha Dios wan stewioch t'ayex ayik skalan juntzanh tik. Yuj chi', sk'exul Cristo kaji, tzonh tewi t'ayex to tzex och junk'olal yet' Dios.
Ha Cristo, malaj jab'ok chukal sk'ulejnak. Palta ha Dios ak'jinakoch masanil ko mul t'a yib'anh, yuj chi' syal Dios to wach' onhxo t'a yichanh, yujto junxonhej kaj yet' Cristo.
Ha onh tik ketmunlajwumal ko b'a t'a smunlajel Dios, yuj chi' tzonh tewi t'ayex to max he patikejel-laj swach'k'olal ix yak' t'ayex.

Yujto A' alannakkan icha tik t'a Slolonel Tz'ib'ab'ilkani: Ha t'a jun pekti' wach', ix wab'i tas ix ala'. Yet' t'a stiempoal yak'ji kolnab'il ix in och het'ok, xchi Dios. Ha tiknaik, toxo ix ja jun pekti' wach' yalnakkan chi'. Toxo ix ja pax stiempoal yak'ji ko kolnab'il chi' tiknaik.
Malaj b'aj chuk skutej ko b'a t'a junok mach, yik malaj mach sb'uchan ko munlajel.
Masanil tiempo sko ch'oxel ko wach' b'eyb'al, yujto schekab' Dios kaji. Tek'tek' skutej ko b'a kak'an techaj juntzanh yaelal, juntzanh ko tzapanil ko majanil yet' juntzanh tas sja t'a kib'anh.
Ay b'aj tzonh mak'ji, tzonh ak'jioch t'a preso. Ay b'aj sk'e b'ulnaj heb' anima kuuj. Ay b'aj tz'el kip ko munlaji. Ay b'aj max onh waylaj. Ay b'aj skak' techaj wejel.

Scheklajeli to schekab' Dios kaji yujto te tojolnhej skutej ko pensar, kojtakxo juntzanh sch'oxnakkan Dios chi', niwan skutej ko k'ool, wach' skutej ko pensar, haxo Yespíritu Dios ayoch t'ayonh, t'a wal yel xajan heb' anima kuuj.

Ha jun k'ayb'ub'al skalel tik, te yel. Ayoch spoder Dios ket'ok. Icha junok soldado skol sb'a yet' juntzanh syamk'ab', syak'lab'an pax yak'an owal, icha chi' skutej ko b'a, yujto te tojol skutej ko pensar.
Ay b'aj ay kelk'och t'a sat heb' anima, ay pax b'aj malaj tzonh ochi. Ay b'aj tzonh alji wach'il, ay pax b'aj tzonh b'uchji. Ay heb' snaani to tonhej skesej, palta yel skala'.
Syalan heb' to manh onh yojtakok heb', palta ojtakab'il onh. Ay b'aj tzonh ak'jioch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, palta hanheja' pitzan onh. Tz'ak'jioch ko yaelal, palta max onh chamlaj.
Wach'chom tz'ak'ji ko kusk'olal, palta masanil tiempo tzonh tzalaji. Wach'chom meb'a' onh, palta tzijtum heb' sb'eyumaxkan kuuj. Wach'chom malaj tas ay t'ayonh, palta icha wal to kik tastak smasanil.
Ha exxo ex aj Corinto, syalnhej kalan t'ayex. Masanil tas ay t'a ko pensar ix kal t'ayex.
Malaj junok tas ix ko k'ub'ejeli. Palta a ex tik, ay juntzanh tas tze k'ub'ejel t'ayonh.
Icha stewi junok mamab'il t'a heb' yuninal, icha chi' tz'aj in tewi t'ayex to tze jak he pensar t'ayonh, icha ix kutej ko jakan kik t'ayex.
Max yal junnhej skutej ko b'a yet' heb' manh creyenteok, yujto manh smojok icha chi'. Icha sakil k'inal max yal junnhej tz'aj yet' k'ik' k'inal, icha pax chi' tojolal, max scha sb'a yet' chukal.
Ha spensar Cristo, max scha sb'a yet' yik winh Satanás. Ha onh creyente onh tik, manh lajanok ko pensar yet' heb' manh creyenteok.

Ha juntzanh komon Dios, malaj yalan yik yet' heb' skajnub'xo Dios yaji. Yujto a onh tik, skajnub' onhxo Dios pitzan, icha ix yalkani: Ha in tik, ol in och kajan t'a heb', ol in b'eyek' yet' heb'. Ol in och sDiosalok heb'. Haxo heb' ol och in chonhab'ok, xchi.
Yuj chi' yalnakpaxkan Dios Kajal chi' icha tik: Elanhek t'a skal heb', iq'ek el he b'a. Manh eyam pax junok malaj swach'il. Tato icha chi' tzeyutej he k'anab'ajani, ol ex in cha wikok.
Ol in och he Mamok. Ha exxo ol ex och wuninalok, wisilok, xchi Kajal chi', haton Dios masanil tas syal yuj, xchi t'a Slolonel Tz'ib'ab'ilkan chi'.

Yuj chi', ex xajanab'il wuuj, haton juntzanh tik yalnakkan Dios t'ayonh. Yuj chi' ko wach' aktejekkan masanil juntzanh tz'ak'an juwokel ko niwanil yet' ko pensar t'a yichanh Dios. Kaq'ek wal kip ko wach' ak'anoch ko pensar t'a Dios, yujto te ay yelk'och t'ayonh.
Hak'ek och he k'ool t'ayonh. Malaj junok ex b'aj ochnak ko mul. Malaj junok ex ko junakel he pensar. Malaj pax junok ex ko k'exanh tiejnak ex.
Manh yujok wak'anoch junok tas t'a eyib'anh swalanb'at juntzanh tik t'ayex. Yujto toxo ix wal t'ayex to te naan ex kuuj. Yuj chi', wach'chom pitzan onh, mato tzonh chami, palta junnhej kaj heyet'ok.
Tzex wak'och yipok in k'ool, tzex walan wach'il. Wach'chom niwan yaelal tz'ak'jioch t'a kib'anh, palta eyuuj sniwanaj in k'ool swab'i. Tzin tzalaj wal eyuuj.
Yiktax ix onh jawi t'a Macedonia tik, maxtzak yal kik'an jab'ok kip, yujto a juntzanh yaelal tik oyanoch t'a ko patik kichanh. Anhej owal tz'ak'jioch t'a kib'anh. Xiwelalnhej kaji.
Palta ha Dios tz'ak'an sniwanil sk'ool jantak mach ayoch t'a skusk'olal. Ha ix ak'an sniwanil ko k'ool, yujto ix ja winhaj Tito t'a tik.

Manh yujoknhej to ix ja winhaj Tito chi' ix ak'ji sniwanil in k'ool, palta tzonh tzalaj pax eyuuj, yujto ix eyak' sniwanil sk'ool winh ayik ix ek' winh t'ayex. Ix yalan winh t'ayonh to he gana tzin he yila'. Ix yalanpax winh to tzex kus wal yuj jun ix uji t'a he kal chi'. Ix yalanpax winh to tzin he nakoti. Yuj chi' ix wach' ja in tzalajk'olal eyuuj.
Wach'chom te kusnak ex yuj jun carta in tz'ib'ejnakb'at t'ayex, palta maxtzak in kus yuj tiknaik. Wach'chom t'a sb'ab'elal kusnak in yuj jun carta chi', yujto wab'nak to kusnak ex jaye' k'ual yuj.

Haxo tiknaik, tzin tzalaji manh yujok to kusnak ex yuj, palta tzin tzalaj tiknaik, yujto yuj jun he kusk'olal chi' ix he na he b'a. Ix ex kus icha wal t'a snib'ej Dios, yuj chi' manh jab'ok ix juwiel he pensar wuuj.

Tato tzonh kus icha wal snib'ej Dios, yuj jun ko kusk'olal chi' sko na ko b'a yik tzonh kolchaji. Tato icha chi', max onh te kuslaj yuj. Palta ay junxo makan kusk'olal. Ha jun chi', yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik yaji. Ha heb' skus icha chi', tonhej sb'atkan heb' t'a chamel t'a junelnhej yuj.

Palta a exxo tik, ochnak he kusk'olal icha snib'ej Dios. Yuj chi' naekkoti tas ajnak ex yuj. Ochnak ex wal t'a ilk'olal sik'lab'il. E sayannak modo tas tz'aj he kolan he b'a. Kotnak eyowal yuj jun chukal ujinak t'a he kal chi', xiwnak ex pax yuj. E nib'ejnak wal in he k'umej. E nanak eyak'b'at t'a yib'anh jun winh ochnak smul chi'. Icha chi' eyutejnak he ch'oxani to manhxo ex lokanok t'a jun chukal chi'.

Ha jun in carta chi', manh yujok jun winh ochnak smul chi' in tz'ib'ejnakb'ati. Manh yujok pax jun mach yab'nak syail yuj jun chukal chi'. Palta in tz'ib'ejnakb'at t'ayex yik snachajel eyuuj to ha t'a yichanh Dios, te xajan onh eyuuj.

Yuj chi' ix ak'ji sniwanil ko k'ool. Manhoknhej ix ak'ji sniwanil ko k'ool. Ix wach' ja pax ko tzalajk'olal ayik ix yalan winhaj Tito to ix te tzalaj winh heyet'ok, yujto ix wach' ja sniwanil sk'ool winh eyuuj he masanil.

Ha t'a yalanh, ix walel he wach'il t'a winhaj Tito tik. Haxo tiknaik, max in q'uixwi, yujto walnak jun chi'. Masanil tas kalnak t'ayex, te yel. Hanhejtona', ayik skalan he wach'il t'a winhaj Tito tik, te yel juntzanh skal chi'.

Ha winh tik, te xajan exxo pax yuj winh tiknaik, yujto snakot winh tas eyutejnak he k'anab'ajan tas yalnak winh t'ayex. Snaanpaxkot winh to emnakil eyutejnak he b'a he chaan winh, xiwk'olal eyutejnak he b'a t'a winh.
Tzin tzalaj tiknaik, yujto syal ex wak'anoch yipok in k'ool.
Ha tiknaik, ex wuk'tak ex wanab', tzin nib'ej swal t'ayex tas ix aj scheklajel swach'k'olal Dios t'a heb' creyente t'a junjun iglesia t'a yol yik Macedonia tik.
Wach'chom ix ak'ji prowal heb' yuj juntzanh yaelal ix ja t'a yib'anh heb', palta ix te tzalaj heb'. Wach'chom te meb'a' heb', palta haxo swilani, niwan slaj yak' heb', icha yak'an heb' b'eyum.
Swak' testigoal in b'a yuj heb', yujto yelk'olal ix yak' jantak ix techaj yuj heb'. Te ek'alto wal ix yak' heb'.
Ix tewi heb' t'ayonh yik sko cha yak' skolwal heb', yujto snib'ej pax heb' skolwaj t'a heb' yikxo Dios.

Ix ko naani to kennhej jab'ok ol yak' heb', palta yelxo wal más niwan ix yak' heb'. B'ab'el ix yak'och sb'a heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Kajal Jesús. Hanhejtona' ichato ix yak'pax sb'a heb' t'ayonh icha snib'ej Dios.
Yuj chi' sko k'anxi pawor t'a winhaj Tito tik yik sb'atxi winh ex yila'. Ha winh ol b'at chaan eyofrenda ol eyak' yuj swach'il he k'ool. Yujto ha t'a winh ix he chael yich eyak'ani.

Manh jantakok swach'il tzeyutej he b'a. Tzeyak'an wal och t'a he k'ool. Jelan tzeyutej he b'a he k'ayb'ani. Yelk'olal te wach' tzeyutej he b'a he k'ulan junok tasi. Tzonh he xajanan paxi. Yuj chi' tze ch'ox pax he wach'il eyak'an eyofrenda chi'.
Ha jun swalb'at tik t'ayex, manh cheknab'ilok yaji. Tonhej in gana tzeyab'i chajtil syutej juntzanhxo heb' yak'an skolwal, yik scheklajeli to t'a wal yel tze xajanej heb' ketcreyenteal.

Kojtak to a Kajal Jesucristo, te niwan swach'k'olal. Wach'chom manh jantakok sb'eyumal t'a satcha'anh, palta ix ul yak'och sb'a mheb'ail kuuj. Icha chi' ix yutej sb'a, yik wach' yuj smheb'ail chi' tzonh och b'eyumal.
Yuj he wach'ilok swalb'at t'ayex tas tzin na yuj eyofrenda chi'. Ix el yab'ilal he chaanel yich he yak'ani, yujto ix el wal t'a he k'ool eyak'ani.
Ha tiknaik, in gana to tzeyak' eyip he wach' ak'ankani. Icha ix eyutej he chaanel yich eyak'an t'a smasanil he k'ool, icha chi' tzeyutej he lajankan tiknaik, hato syala' tastak ay t'ayex.
Chab'il kofrenda chi' yuj Dios hato syala' tastak ay t'ayonh, tato manhok yet' chab'k'olal skak'a'. Max sk'anlaj tato malaj tas t'ayonh.
Mantok in gana tzex ochkan mheb'ail, yuj slajwiel tastak ay t'ayex, yik tzex kolwaj t'a juntzanhxo heb'.

Palta in gana lajan tzonh aj ko masanil. Ha tiknaik, a tas syak' sobre t'ayex, syal eyak'an t'a heb' max tzak'wan yiko'. Haxo t'a junelxo, haxo heb' ol ak'anxok pax t'ayex ayik manh ol ex tzak'wan t'a he yiko'. Tato icha chi', lajan ol onh aj ko masanil.
Yujto icha tik syalkan t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani: Ha heb' niwan tas smolkani, max yak'laj sobre yik heb', haxo heb' jab'nhej tas smolkani, max yak'laj palta t'a heb', xchi.
Swak' yuj diosal t'a Dios, yujto a tz'ak'an sna winhaj Tito yik tzex sya'ilej winh, icha ix wutej ex wilan a in tik.
Ayik ix ko k'anan pawor t'a winh yik sb'at winh ex yila', elanhchamel ix tak'wi winh. Toxon snib'ej pax winh sb'at ex yila', yuj chi' ol b'at winh.
Ay junxo winh kuk'tak ol ko chekb'at yet' winh. Ha jun winh kuk'tak tik, tz'alji winh wach'il yuj heb' creyente ay t'a junjun iglesia, yujto smunlaj wal winh yalanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il.

Hanhejtona', haton jun winh kuk'tak tik sik'nakelta heb' creyente t'a junjun iglesia, yik tzek' schaan jun ofrenda chi' winh ket'ok. Wan ko molan jun ofrenda tik, yik ol cheklaj swach'il Kajal Jesús yet' swach'il he k'ool a ex tik.
Ko gana a onh tik to malaj mach tzonh alub'tanhan yuj chajtil tz'aj ek' kik'anchaanh juntzanh ofrenda tik.
Yuj chi' te tojol skutej juntzanh tik. Manhoknhej t'a yichanh Kajal Jesús tojol skutej ko b'a, hanhejtona' tojol skutej ko b'a t'a yichanh heb' ketanimail.

Ay junxo winh kuk'tak ol ko chekb'at yet' heb' winh tik. Ha jun winh tik, tzijtum elxo skila' to wach' smunlaj winh t'a yik Kajal Jesús. Ha tiknaik, yel ay snib'ej winh smunlaji, yujto tzex yak' wal och winh yipok sk'ool.

Tato ay heb' sk'anb'an winhaj Tito chi' t'ayex, tzeyal t'a heb': Yetb'eyum sb'a winh yet' winhaj Pablo, ayul winh munlajel t'a ko kal tik, xe chi. Tato ay pax mach sk'anb'an yuj chawanh heb' winh kuk'tak yetb'eyum sb'a yet' winhaj Tito tik, tzeyal t'a heb': Ha heb' winh tik, chekb'ilkot heb' winh yuj juntzanhxo iglesia, scheklaj wal el swach'il Cristo yuj heb' winh, xe chi.
Ayik ol k'och heb' winh ta', tze xajanej heb' winh. Tato icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a t'a heb' winh, ol he ch'ox t'a heb' creyente t'a junjun iglesia to yel skala' ayik ix ex kalan wach'il.
Ha eyofrenda ol eyak' t'a heb' yikxo Dios, manh yowalilok tzato walb'at t'ayex yuj.

Yujto wojtakxo to ay wal he gana tzex kolwaj t'a heb'. Wan ex walan wach'il t'a heb' aj Macedonia tik. Icha tik swal t'a heb' eyuuj: Ha heb' ay t'a yol yik Acaya, yab'ilalxo skajwi heb' yak'an yofrenda, xin chi. Ayik ix yab'an heb' aj Macedonia tik to yelk'olal tzeyak' eyiko', tzijtum heb' ix he kuchb'ej yak' yiko'.

Palta ol in chekb'at heb' winh kuk'tak tik t'ayex, yik manh ol juwok jun ix wal tik eyuuj, yujto ix wala' to wach' ex. Ol in chekb'at heb', yik wach' listaxo yaj eyofrenda, icha ix wutej walan chi' eyuuj.

Talaj ay heb' aj Macedonia sb'at wet'ok, haxo syilan heb' to manh listaok heyaj eyak'an eyofrenda chi', axom in q'uixwib'at chi' b'ian. Yujto toxo ix ex wak'och yipok in k'ool. Ha exxo tik ol ex q'uixwok paxi.

Yuj chi' ix in na to yowalil tzin k'an pawor t'a heb' winh kuk'tak tik, yik ol b'ab'laj b'at heb' winh t'ayex. Ol b'at kolwaj heb' winh heyet'ok eyik'anchaanh eyofrenda icha ix eyutej eyalankani. Tato icha chi', lista ol eyutok eyofrenda chi', ol eyak'an yet' smasanil he k'ool, yik manh ol onh b'at ex kak' pural eyak'ani.
Tze nakot jun tik. Ha heb' jab'nhej tz'awani, jab'nhej sjach' heb'. Haxo heb' niwan tz'awani, niwan pax sjach' heb'.
Junjun ex tze na jantak tzeyak'a'. Manh chab'k'olalok tzeyak'a'. Manh ak'b'ilok pural, yujto ha Dios sxajanan heb' tz'ak'an wal t'a tzalajk'olal.
Ha Dios syal yak'an masanil tas t'ayex yuj swach'k'olal. Syak'anpax masanil tas tz'och eyuuj t'a masanil tiempo. Ol to yak'pax sobre t'ayex, yuj chi' tzijtum tastak b'aj syal tzex kolwaji.
Yujto icha tik syalkan t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani: Tzijtum tas ix yak' t'a heb' meb'a'. Haxo swach' spensaril jun chi', ol snakot Dios t'a masanil tiempo, xchi.

Ha Dios tz'ak'an jantak inhat tz'awchaji. Syak'anpax jantak tas swaji. A' ol ak'an t'ayex juntzanh tas ol eyak' eyofrendaok. Ichato ol eyawej. Haxo jun spak ol yak' t'ayex yuj swach'il he k'ool chi' ol yak' q'uib'ok, ol he jach'ani.
Yuj chi' niwan swach'il ol he cha'a, yik ol eyak'an nanhalokxo. Ayik ol kik'anb'at eyofrenda chi' t'a heb' yikxo Dios, tzijtum heb' ol ak'an yuj diosal t'a Dios yuj ayik ol schaan heb'.
Yujto a jun kolwal chi', manh yujoknhej skolwaj t'a heb' t'a stzapan majanil, palta a yopisio, to yuj ol yak' yuj diosal heb' t'a Dios t'a smasanil sk'ool.

Ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'a Dios, yujto a jun eyofrenda chi' wan sch'oxani to wan he k'anab'ajan tas ix yalkan jun wach' ab'ix yik Cristo. Hanheja' ol yal pax wach' lolonel heb' t'a Dios yuj jun niwan kolwal tzeyak' t'a heb'. Yujto a jun chi', ol kolwaj t'a masanil heb' yikxo Dios.
Ha heb' ol chaanok, ol yak' lesal heb' eyuuj. Ol ex sxajanej heb', yujto niwan swach'k'olal Dios ol yak' t'a heb' eyuuj.
Kaq'ek yuj diosal t'a Dios yuj jun Kolwajum ix yak'kot t'ayonh, manhxo jantakok swach'il.

Ha Cristo, te emnakil yutejnak sb'a, te wach' yutejnak spensar. Icha yutejnak sb'a chi', icha chi' swutej in tewib'at t'ayex a in Pablo in tik. Tz'alji, tob' emnakil swutej in b'a ayik ay in ek' heyet'ok, axob' yik ayinek' t'a najat, tob' te ow in.

Palta tzin tewi t'ayex to ayik ol in k'och ta', manh yowalilok ow ol wutok in b'a. Yujto ayex tzeyala' to icha heb' komon anima swutej in b'a. Ha in tik max in xiwlaj wilan pax och in sat yet' heb' tz'alan icha chi'.
Yel toni, anima onh. Palta manh lajanok skutej kak'an owal icha syutej heb' komon anima chi'.

Manhok juntzanh tas ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik sko yamk'ab'ej ayik skak'an owal. Palta anhej juntzanh tas b'aj ayoch spoder Dios sko yamk'ab'ej, yik wach' a juntzanh tz'alji to ay yip, skan t'a yalanh kuuj.

Skan juntzanh komon jelanil kuuj t'a yalanh. Ay heb' max ojtakanel Dios yuj yak'umtakil, palta yalnhej tas junok ak'umtakil chi', skan t'a yalanh kuuj. Haxo juntzanh komon pensar, skak'och t'a yol sk'ab' Cristo smasanil, yik wach' a heb' snaan juntzanh chi', sk'anab'ajejnhej Cristo chi' heb'.
Haxo yik tzaxo onh he k'anab'ajej, a onhxo tik lista ol kutej ko b'a kak'an syaelal heb' manh ol onh k'anab'ajanok.
Ha exxo, anhej tas tzeyil yet' he sat snachajel eyuuj. Ay heb' t'a he kal tz'alani to a Cristo ay yik heb'. Nachajokab'el yuj heb' to hanhejtona' yik in pax Cristo chi' yet' heb'.

Wach'chom tzin ek' t'a yib'anh walan t'ayex yuj jun wopisio tik, palta manh ol in q'uixwok yuj. Ha Kajal Jesús ak'jinakoch wopisio, yik swak'och he tek'anil. Manh yujok ex wak'an juwok ix yak'an wopisio tik.
Icha tik swutej walan t'ayex, yik manh ol he na' to tonhej in gana tzex in xib'tej yuj juntzanh in carta swak'b'at t'ayex.

Yujto ay heb' tz'alan t'a in patik icha tik: Ha juntzanh scarta winh, te ow yalani, te ay yip. Palta haxo winh, malaj wach' yoch winh. Ha yik slolon winh, malaj swach'il slolonel winh syala', xchi heb'.
Tato ayex tzeyal icha chi', nachajokab'el jun tik eyuuj. Icha swutej in tz'ib'anb'at t'ayex ayik ayinek' t'a najat tik, icha chi' ol wutok pax in b'a ayik ol in k'och ta'.

Ha in tik, max in tek'b'ej in b'a in naani to lajan in icha juntzanhxo heb' munil syal sb'a wach'il. Max yal in lajb'an in b'a yet' heb'. Ha heb' chi', malaj spensar heb', yujto ichato a heb' mismo syechtej sb'a t'a yechlab'. Slajb'ej sb'a heb' yet' juntzanhxo heb'.
Ha in tik max wik'chaanh in b'a yuj juntzanh tas b'aj malaj tzin ochi. Ha Dios ch'oxjinak t'ayin b'ajtak lugar b'aj tzin munlaji. Ha chajinak in b'at t'ayex t'a Corinto chi'.
Yuj chi' maj in k'axpaj och t'a junokxo lugar. Q'uinalok maj in xit'ek' junelok t'ayex, malaj am walan wik in munlaj t'a he kal tiknaik. Palta a in b'ab'el k'ochnak in t'ayex yet' yab'ixal Cristo.

Malaj b'aj swik'chaanh in b'a t'a spatik smunlajel junokxo. Max wal-laj tato wik jun munlajel chi'. Palta swak'och junxo tik yipok in k'ool. Ayik ol he wach' ak'anoch Dios t'a he k'ool, eyuuj ol yal in wach' munlaj t'a juntzanhxo lugar b'aj manta junokxo mach smunlaji, palta manh ol in k'axpajek' b'aj ix sch'ox Dios t'ayin.
Ol b'at walanel jun wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il tik t'a yichanhb'at he chonhab' chi', palta manh ol wik'chaanh in b'a t'a spatik smunlajel juntzanhxo heb' ek'nakxo ta'.
Tato ay mach snib'ej syik'chaanh sb'a, max yal-laj. Anhej Kajal Jesús skik'chaanh.
Ay heb' munil syal sb'a wach'il, palta manh yelok to wach' heb'. Anhej heb' syal Kajal Jesús wach'il, anhej heb' chi' wach'.
Komonok tzeyak' techaj juntzanh swalb'at tik t'ayex. Ichato malaj in pensar swalanb'ati, palta tzeyak' techajok.

Tzex in ya'ilej wal, icha syutej Dios ex syailani. Yujto toxo ix wak' in trato yet' Cristo to ol ex wak'och t'a yol sk'ab'. Icha junok ix kob'es ix manta winak tzek' t'ay, tz'ak'ji entregar t'a winh yetb'eyum, icha chi' ol ex wutok wak'an och t'a yol sk'ab' Cristo.

Palta tzin xiwi, talaj icha ajnak ix Eva yak'ji musansatil yuj sjelanil jun yak'nakoch sb'a chanil, talaj icha chi' tzex aj eyak'ji musansatil. Haxo tz'aji tzeyik'el he pensar t'a spatik Cristo, manhxo tojolok pax tzeyutej he b'a icha snib'ej.

Ha ex tik stechaj eyuuj, wach'chom yalnhej mach tzek' alanel junokxo ch'ok k'ayb'ub'al t'a he kal, yujto ichato ch'ok junokxo Jesús tzek' yalel heb', manhok jun tzek' walel a in tik, palta wan he chaan eyab' t'a heb'. Wan he chaan junxo espíritu t'a heb', palta manh ichok jun chab'ilxo eyuuj. Wan eyak'anoch he k'ol t'a junxo ab'ix yik kolnab'il tzek' alji, palta manhok jun ix eyab' t'ayin.
Ha heb' chi', schekab' Cristo yaj heb' yalani. Palta a tzin naan a in tik, to manh ek'alok yelk'och heb' t'ayin.
Wach'chom malaj swach'il in loloni, palta a tas wojtak, ay wal yip. Jantaknhej juntzanh tas ek' in k'ulejnak t'a he kal, a sch'oxan t'ayex to ay tas wojtak.

Ayik wek' walel wach' ab'ix yik Dios t'a he kal ta', malaj in tojol in k'an t'ayex, yujto a in tik, emnakil wutej in b'a ta', yik a ex tzex wik'chaanh. Palta tzeyala' to malaj swach'il wutejnak in b'a ta'.
Icha wal to ochnak in elk'al t'a juntzanhxo iglesia eyuuj, yujto hata' in cha in tojol, ayik in ek' t'a he kal.

Ayik in ek' t'ayex, wach'chom ay tas yowalil tz'och wuuj, palta maj in k'anlaj t'ayex. Ha heb' kuk'tak aj Macedonia tik xit' ak'an jab' tas ay ochnak wuuj ta'. Malaj junok ex wak'nak och jab'ok in gasto t'a eyib'anh. Hanhejtona' icha chi' ol wutok in b'a tiknaik.
Wach'chom swik'chaanh in b'a walan juntzanh tik, palta malaj junok ex aj Acaya ex chi' syal in he kachanoch waan. Yel swal yuj jun tik, yujto a Cristo ayoch wet'ok, yel syala'.
¿Tas yuj swalb'at juntzanh tik t'ayex tze na'a? ¿Tom yujto manh ex xajanok wuuj? Ha Dios ojtannak jantak tzex in xajanej.

Palta hanheja' icha chi' ol wutok in b'a, ichataxon swutej in b'a wek' t'a he kal. Icha chi' ol wutok in b'a, yik wach' a heb' sayanek' tas syutej yik'anchaanh sb'a, ol kan heb' t'a yalanh wuuj. Yujto syal heb' to lajan yopisio heb' wet'ok.
Ha heb' chi', tonhej stz'ak yaloch sb'a heb' schekab'ok Cristo. Syixtej anima heb' yet' slolonel chi'. Munil skomon ak'ej och sb'a heb' schekab'ok Cristo chi'.
Palta a jun sk'ulej heb' chi', max sat ko k'ool yuj. Yujto icha chi' winh Satanás, stz'ak yak'och sb'a winh yángelok Dios.
Yuj chi' max sat ko k'ool, tato icha pax chi' syutej sb'a heb' schekab' winh to syaloch sb'a heb' tojolal. Palta a wal heb' lak'an ol chaan spak, hato syala' tas ix sk'ulej heb' junjun.

Tik swalb'at junelxo t'ayex, manh he na to malaj in pensar. Palta tato tze na icha chi', aq'ek in permiso in lolon icha junok malaj spensar, yik ol yal wik'anchaanh jab'ok in b'a, icha juntzanh heb' syik'chaanh sb'a.
Ha juntzanh swalb'at tik t'ayex, manhok Kajal Jesús schekan wala'. Ichato manh pensaril waji swalanb'at t'ayex, yujto tonhej swik'chaanh in b'a walani.
Tzijtum heb' syik'chaanh sb'a yuj tas ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Yuj chi' ol wik'paxchaanh jab'ok in b'a yet' heb'.
Yujto a ex tik, jelan ex. Yuj chi', tzeyak' techaj heb' manh pensaril yaj t'ayex, tzex tzalaj yet' heb'.

Ay heb' tzex ak'an pural yik tzeyak'an serwil heb'. Haxo jantaknhej tas ay t'ayex, syik'ek' heb' smasanil, syak'och sb'a heb' yajalil t'ayex, syik'anchaanh sb'a heb'. Ichato ay b'aj stz'itb'at he sat heb', palta tzeyak' wal techaj heb'.

Tzin q'uixwi walanb'at t'ayex, a in tik malaj wip in k'ulan icha syutej sb'a heb' chi'. Palta icha syutej heb' stek'b'an sb'a yalani, icha pax chi' swutej in tek'b'an in b'a walani. Palta wan walan icha junok mach malaj spensar.
Ha heb' chi', hebreo heb', hanhejtona' in, hebreo in paxi. Israel heb', israel in paxi. Yinhtil Abraham heb', hanheja' yinhtil in pax Abraham yet' heb'.

Tato schekab' Cristo yaj heb', a in tik más wal schekab' in t'a yichanh heb'. Wach'chom ayik swalanb'at juntzanh tik t'ayex, swalb'at icha yaj junok mach malaj spensar. Más niwan in munlaj t'a yichanh heb'. Más tzijtum el ix in mak'ji t'a yichanh heb'. Tzijtum el ix in och t'a preso. Tzijtum el pax ix in ak'jioch t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Oel wal smak'nak in heb' wetisraelal, 39 wal tz'uum wik'nak yuj heb' t'a juntak el ayik smak'annak in heb' chi'.
Oxel mak'b'il in pax t'a te' jixk'ab' te'. Junel julb'il in cham yet' k'een yaxk'een. Oxel b'atnak te' barco t'a yol ha' mar t'a walanh. Ha junel, jun k'ual yet' jun ak'wal kannak in t'a sat ha'.

Tzijtum b'aj ek'nak in. Ay b'aj ay smay yuj a niwak ha' yet' pax yuj heb' elk'um. Ay b'aj ay smay yuj heb' wetchonhab' yet' pax yuj heb' manh wetchonhab'ok. Ay b'aj ay smay t'a juntzanh chonhab', b'aj kuseltak yet' t'a yib'anh ha' mar. Ay pax b'aj ay smay t'a skal heb' syaloch sb'a creyenteal.

Ay b'aj te k'unb'inak in, in munlaji. Wab'nak wal syail. Tzijtum el manh in waynakok. Ay b'aj te ochnak in wejel, te takjinakpax in ti'. Tzijtum el ochnak in t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Ay b'aj wab'nak syail yuj siik. Ay b'aj elnak in b'eran yuj manh pichulal.
Manhoknhej juntzanh yaelal tik wab'nak. Yujto junjun k'u, swab' syaelal ayik tzin och ilk'olal yuj heb' creyente t'a junjun iglesia.
Tato ay heb' creyente manto tek'anok, ichato mantalaj in tek'anil yet' heb'. Tato ay junok heb' tz'ak'ji telwok t'a junok chukal, tzin q'uixwi yuj heb', skot wowal.
Tato he gana swik'chaanh in b'a, ol wik'chaanh in b'a yuj juntzanh swalb'at tik t'ayex. Yujto a juntzanh tik sch'oxani to malaj jab'ok welk'ochi.
Ha Dios, haton Smam Kajal Jesucristo, smoj tz'alji wach' lolonel t'ay t'a masanil tiempo. Ha ojtannak to te yel swala'.

Ayik wek'nak t'a chonhab' Damasco, hata' ayek' jun winh gobernador munlajnak t'a jun winh rey skuch Aretas. Ha jun winh chi', yalnak winh to stanhwaj spuertail jun chonhab' chi', yik tzin syam winh snaani.
Palta ha t'a swentenail smuroal schonhab' heb' chi' el in ta, wak'jiem t'unhunhok t'a yol jun xuuk t'a sat lu'um. Icha chi' ajnak in kolchajel t'a yol sk'ab' winh.
Nab'anhej swixtej in b'a walan in b'a wach'il. Más wach' swalb'at t'ayex yuj juntzanh icha wayich yet' juntzanhxo tas sch'oxnak Kajal Jesús t'ayin.

Ay jun winh wojtak, jichan sk'ool winh t'a Cristo. Ha tiknaik schanhlajunhilxo ab'il xit'ek' winh t'a satcha'anh b'aj ay Dios. Manh wojtakok tato ik'jinakb'at sniwanil winh yet'ok, mato maay. Anhej Dios ojtannak.
Wach'chom b'atnak winh yet' sniwanil, mato maay, manh wojtakok. Anhej Dios ojtannak. Palta a jun wojtak
to xit'nakek' winh t'a jun lugar skuchan paraíso. Hata' yab'nak juntzanh lolonel winh malaj mach ojtannak. Malaj pax spermiso winh yalan t'a junokxo anima.

Ha jun winh chi', syal walan swach'il winh, palta a inxo tik, manh ol wik'chaanh in b'a. Ay juntzanh tas ayoch t'ayin sch'oxani to malaj welk'ochi. Ha juntzanh chi', ol wala' yik swik'chaanh jab'ok in b'a.

Q'uinalok yelk'olal in gana swik'chaanh in b'a tiknaik, tato icha chi', max am wal icha junok malaj spensar, yujto anhej juntzanh tas yel, anhej am swala'. Palta manh ol wik'chaanh in b'a icha chi', yujto malaj in gana syal heb' to más niwan welk'och t'a tas syil heb' yet' t'a tas syab' heb' t'ayin.

Ha juntzanh tas ch'oxb'il t'ayin t'a satcha'anh chi', yelxo wal niwan yelk'ochi, ay smay wik'anchaanh in b'a yuj. Yuj chi' ay jun in yaelal yak'nak winh Satanás yik tzin ixtani. Ha jun chi' lajan icha junok niwan q'uiix tz'isanb'at t'ayin. Icha chi' ajnak in, yik wach' max wik'chaanh in b'a.
Oxel in k'annak t'a Kajal Jesús, yik talaj syik'el t'ayin.

Palta icha tik ajnak yalan t'ayin: Stechaj uuj yujto tzin och het'ok. Yujto ha t'a heb' malaj wal yip t'a yol yiko', hata' wach' scheklajel in poder, xchi t'ayin. Yuj chi', swak' wal och t'a in k'ool to ol in te tzalajok, yujto malaj wal wip, yik swach' ak'ej spoder Cristo t'ayin.

Yuj chi' tzin tzalaj tiknaik, yujto malaj wip. Wach'chom tzin b'uchji, wach'chom malaj tas ay t'ayin, wach'chom tz'ak'jioch in yaelal, wach'chom swab' syaelal yuj Cristo, palta tzin tzalajnhej. Yujto ayik malaj welk'och jab'ok, más ay in poder.

Ichato malaj in pensar ayik ix walan in b'a wach'il t'ayex. Palta a ex ix in eyak' pural, yuj chi' ix wala', palta a ex smoj tzin eyal wach'il. Ha t'a heb' munil syak'och sb'a schekab'ok Cristo, ha t'a heb' tzeyak'och janik' he pensar. Wach'chom malaj tzin och a in tik, palta malaj yelk'och heb' t'a wichanh.

Ayik ix in ek' t'a he kal, tek'tek' ix wutej in b'a in munlaji. Ix in b'o juntzanh milagro yet' juntzanhxo tastak sch'oxanel spoder Dios. Ix te sat he k'ool eyilan juntzanh ix in b'o chi'. Yuj juntzanh chi' scheklajeli to t'a wal yel schekab' in Cristo.

Icha wal swach'il ix wutej in b'a, ayik ix in ek' t'a heb' creyente t'a junjun iglesia, icha chi' ix wutej in b'a ayik ix in ek' t'ayex. Anhej b'ian to maj wak'och in b'a t'a yalanh he gasto. Palta aq'ek niwank'olal yuj jun in mul ix och tik t'ayex.

Ha tiknaik, listaxo waj in b'atxi t'a yoxelal t'ayex, palta hanheja' manh ol wak'och in b'a he cuentaok, yujto max in nib'ejoch tastak ay t'ayex, palta a he wach'il a chi' tzin nib'ej. Ha heb' mamab'il, smoj smolb'an stumin heb' yik syak' heb' t'a heb' yuninal. Manhok heb' uninab'il chi' smolb'ej stumin yik syak' heb' t'a heb' smam chi'.

Ha in tik, in gana tzin lajel tastak ay t'ayin, yik ol b'oxok he pensar. Wach'chom ol lajwel in niwanil tik yujto tzex in k'ayb'ej, palta ol in tzalajnhej. Tato tzex in te xajanej, ¿tom yuj chi' maxtzak in he xajanej a ex tik?
Ay juntzanhxo heb', wach'chom yojtak heb' to maj wak'och in b'a he cuentaok, palta syal heb' to tzex wak' musansatil yet' in jelanil yik tzex wak' ganar.
¿Tom wak'nak ex musansatil yet' junok heb' in cheknakb'at t'ayex?

In k'annak pawor t'a winhaj Tito yik sb'at winh ex yila'. In chekannakb'at junxo winh kuk'tak yet' winh. ¿Tom xit'nakek' winhaj Tito chi' ex yak' musansatil jun? Lajannhej kutejnak ko pensar kek' t'a he kal ta'.

Tekan ayex tze na'a to tonhej tzin kol in b'a t'a eyichanh. Palta manh ichok ta' swutej in b'a. Yujto t'a yichanh Dios wan walanb'at juntzanh tik t'ayex, icha pax snib'ej Cristo, yik ol laj och he tek'anil t'a yik Dios.

Tzin xiw in b'at ex wila'', talaj manh ichok in gana tzeyutej he b'a. Ha inxo tik, talaj manh ichok he gana swutej in b'a. Tzin xiw in b'at t'ayex ta', ta icha chi' ayto owal, chichonk'olal yet' k'ak'alk'olal t'a he kal. Tato icha chi' ayexto tzeyik'chaanh he b'a, ayexto tzex b'uchwaj t'a he patik junjun ex, ayexto tzex alwi pekal, ayexto tzeyak' ak'umtakil, talaj ayexto pax wan he somchitan he b'a.

Tzin xiw in b'atxi t'ayex, talaj icha chi' ha Dios tzin ak'an q'uixwelal eyuuj. Talaj icha chi' tzin ok' eyuuj, yujto ha t'a yik yalanh, tzijtum ex ix he k'ulej juntzanh chukal. Manh jab'ok tzeyaktejkan he k'ulan juntzanh chukal chi' yet' he niwanil, haton ajmulal yet' juntzanhxo tas te q'uixwelal.
Yoxelalxo ol in b'at ex wila''. Yalnhej tas junok ol b'o'ok, yowalil ayokab' chawanh ma oxwanhok testigo ol alanok, ichato chi' ol b'o'ok.

Ayik ix in ek' t'a schaelal, ay jun ix walkan t'ayex. Haxo tiknaik swalb'at junelxo. Wach'chom manh in ayok ek' eyet' ta', palta swalb'ati to a ex ochnak he mul t'a yalanhtaxo yet' ex pax wan yoch he mul tiknaik, ayik ol in k'och junelxo, manhxo ol ex wak'laj niwank'olal. Haton jun tik ix ek' walkan t'ayex.

E gana wal tzeyila' tato a Cristo wan in syamk'ab'ani yik syalan t'ayex. Hato wal yik ol in k'ochok, ol heyilani. Ichato chi' ol nachajel eyuuj. Yujto a Cristo tik, mantok malaj spoder sch'ox t'ayex, palta niwan spoder yik smunlaj t'a he kal.

Yel toni, ayik ix t'unhb'ajk'e t'a te' kulus, ichato malaj spoder. Palta yuj spoder Dios pitzan tiknaik. Hanhejtona', a in pax tik, ichato malaj in poder, palta yuj spoder Dios pitzan in yet' Cristo, yik hanheja' tzin ek' ex in k'ayb'ej.

Tze cham naej wal he b'a junjun ex, yik scheklaji tato yel ayoch Cristo t'a he k'ool. Hak'ek prowal he b'a junjun ex. ¿Tom manh eyojtakok to a Jesucristo ayoch t'ayex junjun ex? Palta tato manh ex creyenteok t'a yel, manh ayokoch t'ayex.
Palta in gana snachajel eyuuj sik'lab'il to a in tik creyente in t'a wal yel.

Tzin lesalwi t'a Dios eyuuj, yik manh ol he k'ulok junok chukal. Manh tonhejok tzin lesalwi eyuuj yik scheklajeli to wach' in munlaji. Palta in gana to wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'eyb'al, wach'chom ichato scheklajeli to manh wach'ok in munlajel.
Yujto max yal wajk'olan in b'a yet' jun lolonel yel, haton t'a jun b'aj swak' wip in munlaji.
Yuj chi', wach'chom malaj wach' wochi, palta tzin tzalaji tato he ex tik ay eyelk'ochi. Hanhejtona', ol in lesalwok eyuuj, yik ol wach' b'o he pensar.

Tzin b'ab'laj tz'ib'ejb'at jun in carta tik t'ayex, yakb'an manto in k'och eyet' ta', yujto malaj in gana te ow ol wutej in b'a t'ayex yuj jun wopisio tik, ayik ol in k'och t'ayex ta'. Ha Kajal Jesús ak'jinak jun wopisio tik, yik swak' he tek'anil. Manh yujok ex wak'an juwokeli ix yak'an t'ayin.

Haxo tiknaik ex wuk'tak ex wanab', ayokab' he tzalajk'olal ta'. Tze wach' b'oan he pensar. Ak'jokab' sniwanil he k'ool. Junxonhej okab' tzeyutej he pensar, junk'olalxonhej tzeyutej he b'a ta'. Ha Dios ol och heyet'ok, haton jun tz'ak'an he junk'olal, jun tz'ak'an pax he xajanej he b'a.
Slaj eyak'laj stzatzil he k'ool yuj he ch'oxani to tze xajanej he b'a.

Ha heb' creyente smasanil t'a tik, syak'b'at stzatzil he k'ool heb'. Cheklajokab' el swach'k'olal Kajal Jesucristo t'ayex, yak'okab' pax swach'k'olal Dios t'ayex. Aokab' Yespíritu Dios tz'och heyet'ok he masanil ta'.
